feeds.title: The Clay Shooting Company Blog
feeds.description: The Clay Shooting Company is a family run business, founded in 2004 by Steve Lovatt, a farmer born and bred with a passion for clay shooting and also a keen competitor himself.

feeds.title: Mid-Valley Clays Blog
feeds.description: Mid-Valley Clays & Shooting School is owned and operated by Dave and Vandy Fiedler. Together with the outstanding instructor group they have assembled, Dave and Vandy have built Mid-Valley Clays & Shooting School into one of the premier facilities on the West Coast.

feeds.title: Kent & Sussex Shooting School Blog
feeds.description: Kent & Sussex Shooting School blog. Lots of useful information on shotgun shooting and clay pigeon shooting from a team of qualified coaches. We are passionate about clay pigeon shooting and the support we offer through our shooting lessons.

feeds.title: Morton Clay Targets Blog
feeds.description: Keep up to day with our latest Clay Target Shooting News, Competitions & Results. A range and membership club built and operated for the interests of the members. Purpose built in Livingston, East Lothian, Morton Clay Targets shooting club is Scotland's only clay and six lane indoor rife range.

feeds.title: Bath Shooting Ground Blog
feeds.description: Enjoy the thrill of clay pigeon shooting and target archery in Bath, with expert tuition for both the novice and experienced shot. Bath Shooting Ground offers bookable sessions for clay pigeon shooting and archery, complete with expert tuition from our friendly professionals.

feeds.title: Clay Sports Shooting Limited Blog
feeds.description: Keep up to date with Clay Sports Shootings' latest news and offers. Clay Sports Shooting is founded and run by Mike Mayers, a competitive clay shooter who in 2019 qualified and was selected for Wales' International Olympic Skeet Team and currently in 2021 Wales International ABT Team.

feeds.title: Clay Pigeon Events Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Clay Pigeon Events. We offer bespoke, simulated clay days for weddings, birthdays, family gatherings, corporate entertaining, charity fund raising events, hen parties, stag parties, practice, or just an excuse for an exciting day with friends! You can choose one of our venues, or we can come to you if you have a suitable piece of land.
